corrections.summary: Moved buildUrl(path, query) out of the fetch try-block in request(). A non-/api/ path is a caller bug and now throws its own Error instead of being reported as ApiError network_error with the 'Verifique se o app está aberto' message. Build re-run after the edit: exit 0.

findings.summary: AC-dm-17 behavior (invalid CNPJ, fix it, click Salvar right after, no stale error) was not exercised in a browser. Not run: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts`. tests/e2e/ does not exist yet and the page that mounts CnpjField/TextField belongs to the phase-1-frontend-companies unit. Deferred to integration.

AC-dm-48 behavior (confirm and cancel for archive, restore and delete; Esc cancels; focus trapped on Cancel-first dialog; no native dialogs) was not exercised in a browser. Not run: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts`. No page mounts ConfirmDialog yet. Deferred to integration.

MoneyField caret-preserving mask and money-typing flow were not exercised in a browser. Not run: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts`. The calculator page that mounts MoneyField is not in this unit. Deferred to integration.

evidence.summary: Run 1, before the httpClient edit: tsc --noEmit clean, vite build succeeded (31 modules, built in 915ms).
Run 2, after the httpClient edit: tsc --noEmit clean, vite build succeeded (built in 1.35s); no error lines in the log.

Read all 9 unit files. Checked TextField blur/revalidate/caret logic, CnpjField and MoneyField against shared/format/cnpj.ts and shared/format/money.ts (maskCnpjInput/maskMoneyInput signatures and return shapes match), ConfirmDialog busy/Esc/Cancel guards against Radix AlertDialog semantics, StatusView roles, and httpClient error mapping against server/http/errorHandler.ts (emits { error: { code, message, ... } }, matching the assumed shape).

messages.text: Run the deferred e2e checks once the pages exist: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts` (AC-dm-17: invalid CNPJ, fix it, click Salvar right after; AC-dm-48: confirm and cancel for archive, restore and delete, Esc cancels, focus trapped, no native dialogs) and `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts` (money masking). Both need the companies and calculator pages to mount these primitives.
httpClient.request() now throws the buildUrl Error (not ApiError) for a path that does not start with /api/. Callers should not catch that case as a network error.
